title: A 2D cell segmentation protocol for monitoring multiple STAT signaling pathways by fluorescence microscopy.
authors: Szanda, Gergo; Wisniewski, Eva; Barna, Laszlo; Turu, Gabor; Mackie, Ken
one_liner_zh: 该文描述基于荧光显微镜的细胞分割协议监测STAT信号通路，属于细胞成像与信号转导分析，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Microscopic cell segmentation typically requires complex imaging, staining, and computational steps to achieve acceptable consistency. Here, we describe a protocol for the high-fidelity segmentation of the nucleus and cytoplasm in cell culture and apply it to monitor interferon-induced signal transducer and activator of transcription (STAT) signaling. We provide guidelines for sample preparation, image acquisition, and segmentation. The approach performs indistinguishably from neural-network-based segmentation while requiring only conventional and cost-effective techniques. The protocol can be adapted to other signaling molecules undergoing nucleo-cytoplasmic shuttling and to high-throughput applications. This protocol enables simultaneous monitoring of two STAT isoforms using only conventional techniques and equipment and improves upon the assay published in Szanda et al.(1).
abstract_zh: 显微细胞分割通常需要复杂的成像、染色和计算步骤，以达到可接受的一致性。在此，我们描述了一种用于细胞培养中细胞核和细胞质高保真分割的方案，并将其应用于监测干扰素诱导的信号转导及转录激活因子（STAT）信号传导。我们提供了样本制备、图像采集和分割的指南。该方法在性能上与基于神经网络的分割无显著差异，且仅需常规且成本效益高的技术。该方案可适用于其他经历核质穿梭的信号分子，并可用于高通量应用。此方案仅使用常规技术和设备即可同时监测两种STAT亚型，并改进了Szanda等人(1)发表的检测方法。
